name: rack railway
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过齿轮与齿条啮合提供牵引的铁路系统。
usage_overview: 齿轨铁路依靠齿轮与线路齿条啮合获得大坡度运行所需的牵引力，在泥石流冲击分析中作为研究对象，用于考察外部冲击下的系统动力特性与运行安全。

complete_examples.text: Rack railway systems are renowned for their exceptional climbing capabilities.
The impact of debris flow impacts on the rack railway system is still in a blank stage.

P090.title: Dynamic characteristics and running safety of the rack railway system under debris flow impact
